sql_templates.description: Fetch needed data for FII/DII flows, regime, breadth, and index.
sql_templates.name: fetch_fii_dii_regime_breadth_index
sql_templates.query:
WITH combined_data AS (
    SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today, f.flow_signal, r.regime, r.confidence, b.advances, b.declines, b.ad_signal, i.close
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f
    JOIN signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
    JOIN breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
    JOIN market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
    WHERE i.index_symbol = 'NIFTY 50'
      AND f.trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
) SELECT * FROM combined_data;
